claims.claim: P-6b | section 4 | When Dolo steps down from the driver side of the cab facing camera-left (toward cantina door at screen-left), his trailing arm facing the cab behind him at screen-right is his character-right arm; the card incorrectly assigns his character-left arm to the cab door frame and his character-right arm (with locked wrist jewelry F) to the forward free position.
claims.reason: For a man facing camera-left, the character-left side is the viewer-right side, the cab's side; the hand on the door frame behind him at screen-right is the character-left hand, as the card writes it. Which hand he leaves on the frame is the writer's choice.
claims.note: Run B: v2 only, verified three ways (drawn state, chip docs (1), probe).

claims.claim: S01-2 | section 4 | In S01-2, Dolo is seated at the counter along the right-hand wall (screen-right) facing the counter/wall; with the entrance behind camera (foreground) and the DJ booth at the back wall (background), facing the right wall places his character-left side toward camera/entrance and his character-right side toward the back wall, swapping his body sides.
claims.reason: Facing the right-hand wall puts a seated man's left side toward the back wall and his right side toward the entrance and the camera; the card is correct and the claim swaps the sides.
claims.note: Run B: v2 only, verified three ways (drawn state, chip docs (1), probe).

claims.claim: P-5 | section 4 | In P-5 frontal windscreen view, the informant sits at screen-right facing camera with Dolo at screen-left; her arm at frame-right (screen-right) is her character-left arm on the outer cabin edge, whereas her arm nearest to Dolo (frame-center) is her character-right arm, creating a spatial contradiction by labeling the frame-right outer arm as the near arm.
claims.reason: "Near arm" names nothing in a frontal two-shot and contradicts "frame-right" if read as near Dolo. The adaptation brief fixes the arm as her character-left (viewer-right, the door side), so "frame-right" stands and "near arm" is replaced in P-5 take 2.
claims.note: Run B: v2 only, verified three ways (drawn state, chip docs (1), probe).
